title: Public Alert No. 05/2026 – Alert on the Mop-up of Counterfeit Dermazin (1% Silver Sulphadiazine) Cream
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Dermazin (1% Silver Sulphadiazine) Cream in circulation, reported by MAH Taylek Drugs Company Limited. The fake bears batch MV5093 (mfd 05/2024, exp 05/2027) and falsely states Salutas Pharma GmbH, Germany as manufacturer. Zonal offices are mopping it
